newsitem.title: UK: RMC reverses opening gains after results.
newsitem.headline: RMC reverses opening gains after results.

text.p: Shares in building materials company RMC Group Plc fell on Thursday after an initial bounce following news that annual profits had totalled 295.3 million stg in 1996.
The shares had climbed as much as 17p to 10.18 stg before falling back to be down 5p at 996p by 0752 GMT.
Analysts had been forecasting pretax pre-exceptional profits of between 248.8 million to 275 million stg, compared with 329 million stg pre-exceptional profits a year ago.

But the headline profit figure was inflated by a change in accounting policy to use average exchange rates. Under the previous system pretax profits would have been 275.8 million stg, still at the top end of analysts forecasts.
"They still beat the consensus by about 10 million and the dividend was decent as well," said Mike Foster, industry analyst at Credit Lyonnais Laing.
"But the shares do not really look that cheap and people are loathed to push the share price up too much short-term."
RMC added 26-1/2p on Wednesday, ahead of the results.
Analysts said that whilst the results at first sight looked solid, the statement accompanying the results was fairly cautious and did not help to encourage buyers.
"The situation in Germany seems to have bottomed out, but for us to get enthusiastic about ReadyMix it would have to be improving a lot more visibly than it is," Foster said.

Demand for the group's main products has fallen in Germany over the last two years in line with the difficult economic environment. The group's German activities account for about 60 percent of earnings.
"The statement underlined that the company is not looking at strong growth in Germany," Foster said.
But the analyst said that on the whole the results were solid and the statement was unlikely to prompt earnings downgrades. Credit Lyonnais Laing maintains its "hold" rating on the shares.
